name: Podrida
description: La Podrida is the Spanish/Latin American equivalent of Oh Hell!. Exact bidding: predict tricks. Key difference: if you cannot follow suit you must play a trump. 'Podrida' = putrid; spoiling others' contracts by giving too many or too few tricks. Argentina, Mexico variants.

rules.objective: Make exact bid. Bid number of tricks; make exactly that many. Score for exact; penalty for over/under.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal. Turn trump. 2. Bid tricks (exact). 3. Play. Follow suit. If cannot follow, MUST play trump (unlike Oh Hell). 4. Score: exact = points; off = penalty. 'Podrida' = spoiling others by giving wrong number of tricks.
